benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: Lifetime Free option from Central Bank Of India suited for travel & miles users.
highlights: The card is meant for privilege class that comes with worldwide acceptability. Central Bank of India Titanium Credit Card is issued in association with MasterCard.
This card has an ATM compatibility that allows you to withdraw cash anywhere in the world to an extent of limits permitted.
3D secure MasterCard secure code for digital usage makes it secure and safe.
Credit-free facility for up to 55 days.
Add-on card can be availed for family members.

pros_and_cons.editorial_summary: Lifetime Free option from Central Bank Of India suited for travel & miles users.
pros: Lifetime Free card with zero annual fee commitment
Backed by Central Bank Of India digital card controls, EMI conversion & merchant offers
cons: No complimentary domestic or international airport lounge access
High 3.5% (+GST) foreign currency markup — poor for overseas spends
Check latest issuer exclusions on rent, utilities, education & wallet loads before high spends
